subject.title: feat: add per-conversation whatsapp debounce config

question: Should conversation-level inbound debounce remain a WhatsApp-owned configuration feature, or should OpenClaw first establish the generic plugin policy API proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106458?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same user need but create different long-term ownership and compatibility contracts; source review cannot safely choose between those product boundaries without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the WhatsApp-owned configuration
options.body: Sponsor this narrower PR as the canonical WhatsApp-specific contract and close or redirect the generic alternative.

options.title: Adopt a generic plugin policy API
options.body: Choose the broader plugin-owned policy design and rework or close this WhatsApp-specific configuration PR to avoid parallel control planes.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep both proposals open only if maintainers want additional channel requirements before committing to either configuration boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt the WhatsApp-owned configuration
recommendation.body: Sponsor this narrower PR as the canonical WhatsApp-specific contract and close or redirect the generic alternative.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both competing implementations and can provide the most direct technical comparison once maintainers select the desired product boundary.
